name: shell-coverage-lane-failures
title: The shell-coverage lane runs the whole suite, so flakes read as coverage failures and two gates disagree about blocking
description: The shell-coverage lane calls unittest discover directly instead of run-tests.sh, so it misses the GIT_CONFIG maintenance guard that exists to stop detached Git repacks racing the suite's short-lived test repositories — and both observed failures build real Git repos. The kcov bash shim is not in their path and is not the cause. Two gates then disagree: ci-result's needs omits shell-coverage so branch protection stays green, while pr-eligibility.py blocks on any FAILURE in the rollup. Resolve as advisory: stop eligibility blocking on it, fail closed for required checks, and test the maintenance-guard hypothesis before suppressing any test.
creator: sdelmas
